title: Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server Database
description: Managed relational database running PostgreSQL with encrypted storage, private DNS resolution, and restricted network access

resource_group_name.title: Resource Group Name
resource_group_name.description: Existing resource group hosting the database (typically an output of the Azure VNet template)

vnet_id.title: Virtual Network Resource ID
vnet_id.description: Azure Resource ID of the VNet for private DNS resolution (typically an output of the Azure VNet template)

location.title: Azure Region
location.description: Azure region where the database will be deployed

storage_mb.title: Storage Capacity (MB)
storage_mb.description: Maximum storage capacity in Megabytes (32 GB minimum per Azure constraints)

admin_password.title: Master Password
admin_password.description: Leave blank to generate a high-entropy cryptographically secure password

backup_retention_days.title: Backup Retention (Days)
backup_retention_days.description: Number of days to retain automated backups

geo_redundant_backup.title: Geo-Redundant Backups
geo_redundant_backup.description: Replicate backups to a paired region for disaster recovery

allowed_ingress_cidr.title: Allowed Ingress CIDR
allowed_ingress_cidr.description: CIDR block permitted to connect to PostgreSQL port 5432. Leave blank to allow only private network access.
